channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: 'If we breached, we breached'
item.description: Armagh manager Kieran McGeeney wasn't making an issue of a breach call which cost his side dearly for the second game in-a-row.

item.title: 'There is a good bit to work on'
item.description: Jim McGuinness wasn't getting carried away after Donegal maintained their perfect record in Division 1 of the Allianz Football League with a comfortable victory over Mayo.

item.title: Oz-bound Canavan to miss League run-in
item.description: Tyrone will be without Darragh Canavan for the latter stages of the Allianz Football League.

item.title: The late Gerry McCarthy and a famous Waterford football victory
item.description: The death of Gerry McCarthy in Dublin on Thursday severed one of the last remaining links with what was one of the great days in the history of Waterford football.

item.title: McAnespie joins Monaghan's walking wounded
item.description: Monaghan's injury problems have deepened after Ryan McAnespie tweaked his hamstring in last Saturday night's Allianz Football League Division 1 loss to Dublin.

item.title: O'Connor disappointed to surrender big lead
item.description: Jack O'Connor cut a frustrated figure after Kerry relinquished an 11-point lead against Galway at a rain-lashed Austin Stack Park last Saturday evening.

item.title: Brennan leaving no stone unturned in talent search
item.description: Ger Brennan has run the rule over a staggering 164 players since becoming Dublin senior football manager last autumn.

item.title: Conroy recommits to Galway
item.description: Paul Conroy has handed the Galway footballers a major boost by returning to training.

item.title: Residents unhappy at parking chaos during Donegal v Mayo clash
item.description: Residents of a housing estate in Letterkenny have hit out at the parking congestion caused by supporters attending last Sunday's Allianz Football League game between Donegal and Mayo in O'Donnell Park.

item.title: McGinley predicts impact sub role for Murphy
item.description: Enda McGinley expects Donegal manager Jim McGuinness to use Michael Murphy as an impact sub this season.
